# pve_replication_jobs (Data Source)

Replication jobs of a node; optionally one job's status and details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_replication_jobs" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `guest` (Number) Only list replication jobs for this guest.
- `item_id` (String) Replication Job ID. The ID is composed of a Guest ID and a job number, separated by a hyphen, i.e. '<GUEST>-<JOBNUM>'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<item_id>.
- `job` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /nodes/{node}/replication/{id} (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `jobs` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/replication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))
